proofs.locator: Article “What does West pitch on the third Club?” with all three discard outcomes
proofs.passage: What does West pitch on the third Club? -          If West pitches a Spade then you cash the ♠A and duck a Spade to West’s King, scoring the 9^{th} trick with the ♠Q -          If West pitches a Heart then you cash the ♥Q and run the ♦J around to West (now West must play on Diamonds or Spades, either of which gives up the 9^{th} trick) -          If West pitches a Diamond then you run the ♦J around to West’s Queen and have the timing to set up the 13^{th} Diamond.   Poor West was squeezed in three suits, but it required accurate card reading to take advantage of that.

proofs.locator: Article “What does West pitch on the third Club?” with all three discard outcomes
proofs.passage: What does West pitch on the third Club? -          If West pitches a Spade then you cash the ♠A and duck a Spade to West’s King, scoring the 9^{th} trick with the ♠Q -          If West pitches a Heart then you cash the ♥Q and run the ♦J around to West (now West must play on Diamonds or Spades, either of which gives up the 9^{th} trick) -          If West pitches a Diamond then you run the ♦J around to West’s Queen and have the timing to set up the 13^{th} Diamond.   Poor West was squeezed in three suits, but it required accurate card reading to take advantage of that.
